note: The Power Automate flows of builds B6, B7 and D5 (D295, D301, D315), as Carlos makes them by hand in the company tenant with the steps of powerbi/README.md §6. One entry per flow: its name (the Power Apps call a flow by it), the trigger, the inputs a Power App gives it, the concurrency of the trigger (1: one run at a time; the others wait) and the steps in order. A flow refreshes, waits, files a report or a reply, sends exactly the message a manager pressed Send or Test on (its To, Cc, Subject, Body and file are the inputs of the trigger, never made by the flow, D2, D301), or makes the Outlook draft a manager pressed Outlook draft on in the manager's own Drafts, which sends nothing (F7, D315). None runs on a timer (D269). npm run powerbi:lint checks these rules and that the apps call only flows of this file. The workspace and the semantic model are picked from a list in the step: the workspace is the one Carlos made (README section 4), the semantic model has the name of the .pbip.

flows.name: SACMRefresh
flows.purpose: Refresh the report after a manager saved an action in the Power App, or pressed Refresh now in it.

flows.name: SACMSend
flows.purpose: Send the email a manager pressed Send on in the Power App SACM messages, from the shared mailbox, exactly as the app gives it: the email of the template (Drafts[Html], D313) and, for a long list, its CSV file (Drafts[Csv], D314). The app records it in the journal after the flow answers.

steps.action: Send an email from a shared mailbox (V2)

flows.name: SACMTest
flows.purpose: Send a test of an email to the manager who pressed Test to me, from the shared mailbox, with its file when it has one. Nobody else gets it, and the cases are not changed.

steps.action: Send an email from a shared mailbox (V2)

flows.name: SACMDraft
flows.purpose: Make an Outlook draft of the email a manager pressed Outlook draft on in the Power App SACM messages, in the manager's own Drafts, with From set to the shared SACM mailbox (D315, the manager needs Send as on it), and give the app its link. It sends nothing: the manager checks the draft and sends it from Outlook, then tells the app (Sent from Outlook? Yes records it).

fields.Body: =input Message with the file Csv and the shared SACM mailbox as From

steps.action: Respond to a PowerApp or flow

flows.name: SACM refresh now
flows.purpose: The button Refresh now on the pages My day and Reports (the Power Automate visual).

flows.name: SACM - File reports
flows.purpose: File each report the shared mailbox gets in the reports folder of the team site, then refresh the report.
flows.trigger: When a new email arrives in a shared mailbox (V2)

fields.File Name: the date of today, an underscore and the name of the attachment

flows.name: SACM - File replies
flows.purpose: File each reply to a SACM message that comes to the shared mailbox (its subject holds [SACM-…]) in the list SACM Replies, then refresh the report.
flows.trigger: When a new email arrives in a shared mailbox (V2)

fields.Title: the reference in the subject: the text from [SACM- to the next ]
fields.Received: the Received Time of the email
fields.Subject: the Subject of the email
fields.Body: the text of the step Html to text
fields.ConversationId: the Conversation Id of the email
